widgets.name: MechJeb
widgets.description: Engage MechJeb's ascent autopilot, execute the next node, or land at the target. Shows the one-way light time each command costs and which commands are still in flight.

actions.label: Engage ascent autopilot
actions.description: Commands the ascent autopilot to fly to the set target altitude.

actions.label: Execute next node
actions.description: Commands execution of the next maneuver node.

actions.label: Land at target
actions.description: Commands an autopilot landing at the selected target.
